meta.title: 当我和对象吵架互放狠话
meta.title_en: When My Partner and I "Fight" with Praise
meta.topic: 情侣互动 · 反向夸奖的内容范式

scenes.context: 让你买苹果你买全家桶，表面吐槽实则夸「这点小事你都干这么好」。
sentences: 我让你买几个苹果，你给我买苹果全家桶。
I asked for a few apples, and you got the whole bucket.
whole bucket（全家桶）
这点小事你都干这么好。
You do even the small things so well.
small things（小事）
你个帅气多金的笨男人。
You handsome, rich, silly man.
handsome（帅气）
paraphrase: A complaint on the surface, a compliment underneath.
You nailed even this tiny errand.
scenes.speak: I asked for a few apples, and you got the whole bucket. You do even the small things so well. You handsome, rich, silly man.

scenes.context: 从「走了八辈子运」到英文 beautiful、hot rich successful，层层加码。
sentences: 我遇见你就是走了八辈子运了。
Meeting you was eight lifetimes of luck.
eight lifetimes（八辈子）
你长得漂亮身材又好。
You're beautiful and fit.
fit（身材好）
你还沉鱼落雁，你个 beautiful girl。
You're drop-dead gorgeous — you beautiful girl.
drop-dead gorgeous（沉鱼落雁）
paraphrase: I've been lucky beyond belief to meet you.
Switch to English to push the joke further.
scenes.speak: Meeting you was eight lifetimes of luck. You're beautiful and fit. You're drop-dead gorgeous — you beautiful girl.

scenes.context: 「看我今天不从了你」到「你根本就是个好男人」盖章定论。
sentences: 你今天非要夸这么狠是吧。
You're really laying it on thick today.
lay it on thick（夸太狠）
看我今天不从了你。
Watch me give in to you today.
give in（从了/屈服）
你除了这你还会干什么？你根本就是个好男人。
That's all you can do? You're a truly good man.
a truly good man（根本是个好男人）
paraphrase: Admit defeat while keeping the smile.
End with a final verdict that warms the heart.
scenes.speak: You're really laying it on thick today. Watch me give in to you today. That's all you can do? You're a truly good man.

practice: A joke where a small request gets a hilarious over-delivery.
A complaint that's secretly a compliment.
Meeting you was eight lifetimes of luck.
A playful threat that ends in a sweet verdict.
pitfalls: 反向夸奖需要双方默契。
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「帥氣多氣」按语境修正为「帅气多金」；「仁傑/暖男」为戏称。
